▝▜██████▀  Opus 5.5 · API Usage Billing
 ▝▝   ▝▝   /tmp/agend-audit/w/gw326

▎ Auto mode is now Claude Code's default permission mode.
▎ Auto mode lets Claude handle permission prompts automatically. Claude checks each tool call for risky actions and prompt injection before executing, runs the
▎ ones it assesses as lower-risk, and blocks the rest.
▎ https://code.claude.com/docs/en/permission-modes

   Login

   Claude Code can be used with your Claude subscription or billed based on API usage through your Console account.

   Select login method:

   ❯ 1. Claude account with subscription · Individual, Team, or Enterprise
     2. Anthropic Console account · API usage billing
     3. 3rd-party platform · Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, Google Vertex AI

   Esc to cancel
